v2.connect.lead: Florin reads your transactions read-only through the European banking API. No payment is ever possible.

v2.connect.mappingLead_one: Your bank has {count} account. Tell Florin whether it's already here, so Florin adds to its existing history instead of creating a duplicate.
v2.connect.mappingLink: Link it — Florin keeps the history that's already on this device.
v2.connect.mappingNewDetail: Florin adds it as a new account.

v2.connect.registerHint: Create an app in Enable Banking, choose “Generate outside the browser”, paste the certificate into it, and enter this redirect URL — exactly as shown. Then don't forget to activate the app in the console:
v2.connect.replaceKeyBody: Enable Banking doesn't let you change the certificate of an existing app: you'll have to create a new one and paste its App ID here again. Your current sync will stop working.
v2.connect.setupLead: A one-time setup, about 2 minutes. Your bank credentials never pass through Florin — you sign in on your bank's own site.

v2.setup.hostHint: The address of your instance, on your network.
v2.setup.hostNote: The port is optional, and so is http:// or https:// — Florin works them out and shows the exact address it will use above.
v2.setup.hostOptional: The port and http:// are optional.
v2.setup.notFlorin: Something is responding at this address, but it isn't Florin.
v2.setup.privacy: Nothing leaves your network: the app shows your own server.
v2.setup.title: Your Florin server
v2.setup.tokenHint: Only if your Florin runs on the web: the value of FLORIN_API_TOKEN on your server. The desktop app doesn't ask for one — leave this blank.
v2.setup.tokenPlaceholder: Leave empty for the desktop app
v2.setup.tooOld: Florin is responding, but this version doesn't support the app's API yet. You'll need to deploy a newer version on the server.
